title: Products — Supreme Art
description: Printed packaging for tablets, capsules, syrups and food products, plus pharmaceutical leaflets and product labels.

range.heading: Packaging for pharmaceutical and food products.
range.lead: From medicine cartons to food packs, leaflets and labels, we print and finish every product to your artwork, dimensions and required specification.

items.title: Tablet packaging
items.text: Printed cartons made to fit tablet blister and strip packs, with accurate dimensions and clear product information.

items.title: Capsule packaging
items.text: Precisely produced cartons for capsule blister, strip and bottle formats in a range of pack sizes.

items.title: Syrup packaging
items.text: Protective bottle cartons for syrups and liquid medicines, with partitions or inserts where required.

items.title: Leaflets & inserts
items.text: Printed and folded information leaflets and package inserts prepared to fit inside the finished pack.

items.title: Labels
items.text: Clear, colour-accurate printed labels for bottles, products and outer packaging.

items.title: Food packaging
items.text: Printed folding cartons and pouches for food products, including masala packaging produced for Stanley Foods and SwaaD Foods.
items.alt: Supreme Art masala and food packaging

cta.heading: Need a specific carton?
cta.text: Send us your artwork or dieline and we'll come back with a quote and a timeline.
